query:
SELECT 
  p.id, p.name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.saleType = 'A_PRAZO' THEN s.finalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_vendas,
  COALESCE(SUM(cp.paidAmount), 0) as total_pagamentos,
  COALESCE(SUM(cd.debitAmount), 0) as total_debitos
FROM partners p
LEFT JOIN sales s ON p.id = s.customerId AND s.saleType = 'A_PRAZO'
LEFT JOIN customerPayments cp ON p.id = cp.customerId
LEFT JOIN customerDebits cd ON p.id = cd.customerId
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Vitor Hugo%'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;
